editorial_thesis: Agent systems are becoming operational surfaces: govern the delivery factory, standardize tool boundaries, and make cost and approval visible before action.

topic_groups.title: Agent Delivery: Govern the Factory, Not Just the Prompt
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh Aug 28 GitHub policy and IDE updates plus current adoption research make governance and economics immediately actionable after yesterday’s developer-delivery lane.

sources.title: Visual Studio Copilot August update
sources.why_selected: New shared agents, effort controls, usage visibility, model management, and pre-PR review make governance actionable.
sources.usefulness: Pilot a scoped organizational agent and track review/cost evidence.

sources.title: Upcoming Copilot policy and billing changes
sources.why_selected: September and October changes affect policy, retention, review defaults, and billing.
sources.usefulness: Audit tenant settings and calendar the change windows.

sources.title: AI coding agent adoption trends
sources.why_selected: Survey data shows weekly agent use at 90% and daily use at 68%, with rapid tool-share movement.
sources.usefulness: Measure task-level tool economics instead of standardizing by habit.

sources.title: Copilot code review resolution reasons
sources.why_selected: Review outcomes become structured feedback for agent and repository improvement.
sources.usefulness: Sample resolution reasons and prioritize repeat false positives.

topic_groups.title: Agent Infrastructure: Build the Full Lifecycle
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Cloudflare’s ADLC framing and managed-connector primitives fill a coverage gap: the practical bottleneck is now lifecycle control, not code generation.

sources.title: The Agent Development Lifecycle
sources.why_selected: Cloudflare argues agents should participate across the full lifecycle, not only implementation.
sources.usefulness: Map one workflow across every lifecycle stage.

sources.title: Google-managed MCP servers
sources.why_selected: Managed endpoints add centralized discovery, IAM, safety, traces, and audit logs.
sources.usefulness: Inventory connectors and replace fragile point-to-point links where appropriate.

sources.title: Google Agent Platform recap
sources.why_selected: Agent Runtime, Identity, long-running agents, Designer, Gallery, and Memory Bank show the platform shape.
sources.usefulness: Draft a minimum agent run record and approval surface.

sources.title: Local traces for agent development
sources.why_selected: Production-like OTel traces in local development make failures reconstructable.
sources.usefulness: Add trace IDs and tool-call evidence to one skill.

topic_groups.title: Physical Systems: Standardize the Instrument Boundary
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Anthropic’s Aug 27 MHS preview is a material update to physical-AI coverage, shifting the focus from simulation to interoperable device contracts.

sources.title: Model Hardware Standard research preview
sources.why_selected: A model-agnostic driver and constraint layer targets interoperable agent control of lab and manufacturing equipment.
sources.usefulness: Draft a capability manifest for one external system.

sources.title: Exploratory reasoning to deterministic script
sources.why_selected: Exploration can be compiled into bounded, repeatable execution.
sources.usefulness: Define promotion evidence and an approval gate.

sources.title: Machine-readable physical constraints
sources.why_selected: Drivers expose capabilities, adjustable parameters, and safety limits.
sources.usefulness: Lint tool manifests and fail closed on missing limits.

topic_groups.title: Agent Commerce: Make Payment a Tool Contract
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Stripe provides a concrete payment implementation for the agentic-web lane; it is revisited only because the protocol adds a materially new operational path beyond earlier x402 coverage.

sources.title: Machine Payments Protocol
sources.why_selected: MPP makes agent payment a protocol interaction for microtransactions and recurring payments.

sources.title: Payment request as the interface
sources.why_selected: Services can return payment terms before delivering an API, MCP, or HTTP resource.
sources.usefulness: Define price, purpose, cap, expiry, and refund fields in receipts.

sources.title: Agent-native service examples
sources.why_selected: Browser sessions, mail, food, climate, and API access illustrate bounded fulfillment.
sources.usefulness: Calculate unit margin for one narrowly scoped service.
